verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes file format support (.babylon, glTF, OBJ), a Playground code-sharing tool, and an Inspector for debugging, but nothing addresses mergeable scene files, diffable text formats, or built-in multi-user collaboration workflows for teams using version control. Babylon.js is code-driven (scenes typically authored in JS/TS), but no docs or community evidence explicitly discuss VCS-friendly scene formats or collaboration tooling. missing for 10: evidence of diff-friendly scene serialization, merge-conflict handling for scene files, or any built-in real-time/multi-user collaboration feature.
